BUCKET.LOCATE.summary: Returns the routing information for a bucket: the member that owns each shard and the addresses of those members.
BUCKET.LOCATE.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of shards the bucket uses.

reply_schema.description: The shard routes and the members named by those routes.

items.description: The routes as a flat list. Every shard adds three entries: the shard id, the id of the primary member and the list of standby member ids. A shard with no known route is left out.
The members as a flat list. Every member adds two entries: the member id and the list of its external addresses. A member is listed once, no matter how many shards it owns.

arguments.name: bucket
arguments.summary: The name of the bucket to locate.
